quest.title: Yanxiao's Crazy Kitchen
quest.description: Smiley Yanxiao from Wangshu Inn seems to be struggling with his workload during the Lantern Rite...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. I've already asked Yuhua to bring the food down to those two customers. They're pretty pleased with it, too — thanks for making that trip.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: So, are all the other matters settled?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've sent those meals out.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Good, good — have you bought the ingredients as well?

talks.objective: Talk to Smiley Yanxiao at night (19:00 – 23:00)

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Argh, I need a rest. My hands are so sore that I can barely lift my wok...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler! I was just wondering how nice it'd be if I could have some help. You up for it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sort of help...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Most all our staff have headed back to spend the Lantern Rite in the city. We're so short-handed right now that we can barely keep our heads above water, so any help is good help.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: You needn't worry, we don't expect you to do any heavy lifting. Just need to help us serve some dishes and gather some ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Give me a moment, let me see what we can get you to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ack, I forgot to take orders from the customers at that table downstairs.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: How about this? Go and take orders from those two guests downstairs, Holderlin and Caspar.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: They've been waiting for a while now, so they might be getting annoyed. Just remember to bring them <color=#00E1FFFF>two</color> side dishes. Some <color=#00E1FFFF>Delicious Chicken-Mushroom Skewer</color> should do the trick.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: After the sides have been served, ask them what they'd like to have for their main course — save yourself that extra trip.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright, run along now. Don't keep them waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuyu
dialogues.text: Look, Qinglian, look — our takeout's here! Thanks for making the trip.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Golden Shrimp Balls.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: No problem, this won't be hard.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: And what would Caspar like to eat?

talks.objective: Serve dishes to Holderlin and Caspar

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jueyun Chili Chicken.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: No problem, this won't be hard.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What would Caspar like to eat?

talks.objective: Serve dishes to Holderlin and Caspar

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: Well, finally! I was just about to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What would you like to order?

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: I've heard that the people of Liyue make excellent seafood, so I'd like to try some...

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: But I've been trying the vegetarian lifestyle out recently, so I can't have meat. I wonder if they have something... vegetarian that tastes like seafood...

dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: Ever since I tried spicy food at Wanmin Restaurant, I've been completely smitten by that flavor. Nowadays, I can't eat anything if it doesn't have that spice in it.

dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: I'll pass on the seafood, I've had too much of it lately. Some fowl would be great.

dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: I'm not too familiar with Liyue cuisine, so I'll take whatever you recommend, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, I've got them down now... Phew, this'll be a busy day and no mistake.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Let me see if there's anything we need your help with... Oh yes, we have two servings of takeout here. Could I trouble you to send them out?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: One serving of Almond Tofu for Aunt Qiao, and a serving of Golden Shrimp Balls for Zhuyu.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Having made so many dishes in such a short time, we're starting to run out of ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: How about this? While you're on your trip, you bring some ingredients back with you. <color=#00E1FFFF>Three servings of</color> <color=#00E1FFFF>Rice, Almonds, and Tofu</color> each should do the trick.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: We really don't have sufficient ingredients on hand right now, so I'll have to trouble you to go out and buy some. You should be able to get all these ingredients from <color=#00E1FFFF>Second Life</color>, just report the bill to me afterwards.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Vegetarian Abalone.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Hmm, that's a tough one. This outlander sure knows how to pick 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What would Caspar like to eat?

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Aunt Qiao

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: So, what did they order?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What would Holderlin like to order?

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Aunt Qiao

dialogues.speaker: Aunt Qiao
dialogues.text: Oh? This is... the delivery from Wangshu Inn?

dialogues.speaker: Aunt Qiao
dialogues.text: Oh yes, this is wonderful... A serving of Wangshu Inn's Almond Tofu on a festive occasion is always great.

dialogues.speaker: Aunt Qiao
dialogues.text: #Thank you, young {M#man}{F#lady}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Vegetarian Abalone.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright, I've got it.

talks.objective: Procure 3 portions of Tofu, Almonds, and Rice

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jueyun Chili Chicken.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: This outlander likes spicy food, does he? Ho, I can do that.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Thanks, you've lightened my load a fair bit.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Haha, aren't I a busy man... It's the Lantern Rite, and I haven't put a lantern together yet...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, right. Traveler, do you know how to make Xiao Lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: It doesn't feel right to ask you for help with this as well, but I really can't spare the time to source for materials to make a lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If you're willing to help out, could you make me one... No, two — two lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I'll take one of them, and I'd like you to help me send the other to Jiangxue. He can usually be found fishing near the inn.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: He's usually something of a freeloader, but for some reason, he hasn't come over today...

talks.objective: Give a Xiao Lantern to Smiley Yanxiao

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: You've got nimble hands. Thank you, I should be able to send this Xiao Lantern off soon.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, yes — make sure you don't forget to pass the other Xiao Lantern to Jiangxue.

talks.objective: Give a Xiao Lantern to Jiangxue

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: A Xiao Lantern? Why so sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Smiley Yanxiao wanted me to send this to you.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Ha, that chef is a thoughtful man indeed. He's... changed a great deal since our initial meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Time slips by, and yet here I am, still unable to wholly let go. How shameful.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can't you let go of?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Nothing, really. Mere trivial matters that aren't worth any mention. Thanks for coming all this way and sending me that Xiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I don't have anything to wish for, nor have I released a Xiao Lantern of my own in a long time...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: But having a lantern by my side to look at isn't too bad. Thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: This is bad...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Lantern Rite's the matter, what else? We've had lots of staff head back to the city to spend the festive period there, so we've got our hands full right now.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Haven't the time for idle chat right now. Need to get ready for the guests' orders at night — doubt I'll even have time to get a sip of water.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If you cared enough to check on me, you might as well help out later tonight.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: *sigh* What I'd do for some help right now. Where's that Yuhua run off to...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ack, I forgot to take orders from the customers at that table downstairs.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: How about this? Go and take orders from those two guests downstairs, Holderlin and Caspar.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: They've been waiting for a while now, so they might be getting annoyed. Just remember to bring them <color=#00E1FFFF>two</color> side dishes. Some <color=#00E1FFFF>Delicious Chicken-Mushroom Skewer</color> should do the trick.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: After the sides have been served, ask them what they'd like to have for their main course — save yourself that extra trip.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright, run along now. Don't keep them waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: We've been here all day, why hasn't anyone come to take our orders yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Golden Shrimp Balls.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright, I've got it.

dialogues.speaker: Aunt Qiao
dialogues.text: Anything I can do for you, youngster?

dialogues.speaker: Zhuyu
dialogues.text: Qinglian, is there anything else you'd like to eat other than Golden Shrimp Balls?

dialogues.speaker: Qinglian
dialogues.text: *cough* Don't worry. Let's wait a while more, the takeout should be here soon.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuyu
dialogues.text: Hmm? Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: You've got some smooth moves, don't you? As expected of an adventurer...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What's with that freeloader today...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Another year, another Lantern Rite...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Why's that girl Yuhua not in the kitchen helping me out...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Taking orders and sending takeout, buying ingredients, serving the food... What else have we got...

dialogues.speaker: Holderlin
dialogues.text: Hope my order arrives soon...

dialogues.speaker: Caspar
dialogues.text: I wonder what I'll be served...

dialogues.speaker: Aunt Qiao
dialogues.text: #Thank you, young {M#man}{F#lady}.

dialogues.speaker: Zhuyu
dialogues.text: Thanks for coming all this way.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Strange — I wonder why those customers don't look too pleased after their dishes arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Did my hand slip somewhere? That can't be...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: So, are all the other matters settled?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've sent those meals out.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Good, good — have you bought the ingredients as well?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Hmm, you were a little slow... *sigh* But there were too many things to do, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Come again at night, I need to hurry up and finish making preparations...
